messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Probabilistic simulated-annealing search reporting best-found coordinates as decimals

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A probabilistic simulated-annealing search over 13 distinct points in the unit square, minimizing a smooth surrogate of the minimum-triangle-area objective via Gaussian-perturbation proposals with exponentially decaying temperature, converges to a configuration whose smallest triangle area approaches approximately 0.0038; the best-found coordinates are (0.000,0.000), (1.000,0.000), (0.000,1.000), (1.000,1.000), (0.500,0.038), (0.038,0.500), (0.962,0.500), (0.500,0.962), (0.269,0.269), (0.731,0.269), (0.269,0.731), (0.731,0.731), (0.500,0.500), achieving a minimum triangle area of 0.00361."}
